no default CDN.detail: The adapter constructs the engine only with explicit same-origin paths: workerPath /assets/tesseract/7.0.0/worker.min.js, corePath /assets/tesseract-core/7.0.0/, langPath /models/tessdata-fast-eng/7d4322bd/, gzip:false, workerBlobURL:false, cacheMethod 'none' - no jsdelivr fallback can be constructed and the worker performs no cache I/O at all. Model bytes are fetched by the adapter itself from the pinned same-origin URL and sha256-verified against the frozen manifest before any use; the adapter's own verified idb-keyval cache is a warm-start store for future preparations only. The payload test captures the launch contract: langs [{code:'eng',data:Uint8Array}] whose sha256 equals the prepared model's, cacheMethod 'none', AbortSignal, Uint8Array PNG input. initialization failure != unreadable pag.detail: Distinct terminal outcomes are tested and observed: 'worker init failure is a terminal failure, never unreadable_pixels' injects a createWorker failure -> check status failed, reason init_crash, zero occurrences; a completed recognition that yields no words -> status completed, reason unreadable_pixels (never a failure, never retried). 'offline-unavailable' and 'model integrity failure and corrupted cache are rejected' cover the model-side terminal states. One transient retry applies to init/worker crashes only, on a fresh worker, inside the same absolute deadline. Wave-4 verified: op-scoped cleanup means a failing operation retires only its own lease - 'superseded open cannot clear the newer handle/worker' and 'a hung engine init at extract time fails timeout and terminates' pass in the 41/41 run.
